items.title: CrashGym: Measuring the Decision Value of Experimentation for LLM Agents in Counterfactual Market Crashes
items.claim: Laboratory access cuts Luna's mean market-crash decision regret by 57.4 percent versus observe-only deployment.

items.title: VQuant: An Agentic Large Language Model Architecture for Automated Quantitative Financial Analysis and Document Generation: Reasoning-Augmented Tool Orchestration, In-Loop Numerical Computation, and Multi-Format Reporting
items.claim: VQuant reports no empirical measurements of accuracy hallucination latency or cost for its agentic finance platform.

items.title: Sealed Before the Open: A Verifiable Standard for Measuring AI Forecasts of Financial Markets
items.claim: Eleven large language models sealed market forecasts into a Bitcoin-anchored hash chain before the New York open.

items.title: Understanding the Inner Workings of a State-Space Foundation Model for Limit Order Books
items.claim: An 8.2-million-parameter Mamba model decodes LOB order-flow imbalance at R²≈0.59 on unseen equities.

items.title: What Prediction-Market Contracts Reveal at Launch: Trading Volume and Dispute Risk
items.claim: Prediction-market launch features predict log-volume at out-of-sample R squared 0.747 but fail temporal generalization to later listing formats.
